第二十六章 林间奇遇埋伏秘物（第1页）
二人一路向前，走到后山一处偏僻的崖边林地。此地远离主路，荒草遍地，林木交错遮挡视线，是防守的薄弱之处。苏晚晴神识尽数铺开，仔细排查隐患，陈默则留意着地面与草丛。
行走间，他脚下忽然触碰到一物，触感坚硬，掩埋在杂草与腐叶之下。陈默弯腰拨开层层落叶，只见一枚巴掌大小的灰褐色木盒静静躺在土中，盒身刻着古朴晦涩的纹路，表面萦绕着淡淡的灵力波动。
小白狐从他肩头跃下，围着木盒转了两圈，鼻尖轻嗅，眼中露出好奇之色。
苏晚晴也快步走近，目光落在木盒上，略一探查便看出端倪：“这是前人遗留的储物小盒，并无禁制，你且打开看看。”
陈默依言掀开盒盖，盒内空空荡荡，只平放着一张暗青色符纸。符纸材质特殊，纸面绘着繁复的阵纹，灵气内敛，寻常修士难以察觉。
“是埋伏类符箓。”苏晚晴一眼辨出物件用途，“此乃隐杀困伏符，一次性法器。预先将符箓埋于地下，待敌人踏入范围，便会自动触发迷阵与偷袭灵光，适合暗中设伏。符箓灵力有限，仅能使用一次，应对猝不及防的闯入者再合适不过。”
说罢，便从自己腰间的一个雪白精致的储物袋内拿出了一个类似的符纸。
陈默看了看，与自己手中的对比此符上的花纹就显得简单不少。并且涂料用的血也应该是平常野兽的血。而自己手中的符的涂料中明显有不小的灵气波动。
苏晚晴惊讶地道:“你这服看来是制符的高手绘制的虽然看似如此老旧，但灵力波动依旧不凡。你小子是撞大运了。”说罢变拍了一下陈默的头。他肩上的狐狸又充了恶毒的眼神回视了一下她。
苏晚晴对此稍显惊讶，于是也回敬了狐狸一个小眼神。心道“此狐难道是吃我的醋？真是有趣。这狐狸看起来灵智不凡。怪哉，怪哉。”
陈默拿起符纸，指尖触碰到纸面，能感受到其中封存的凝练灵力。他心中一喜，但脸上也没有露出丝毫表情。如今局势混乱，这份意外所得，无疑多了一重自保的手段。
他将符箓小心叠起，解开了自己的外衣。从内衣兜里取出了一个。有蓝色条纹的布口袋。他打开来。，发现里面有不少低阶的符纸。这个是他出发那天师姐悄悄递给他的。他想应该是师傅给他准备的。
想起师傅，师姐二人的照顾。他心里面一暖，在这个为了修行，为了宝物就可以丢掉一切放弃人性的社会里这些温情保住了人类仅有的文明。
但为了修行为了心中的信念和理想，人又是什么做不出来的呢？主角也不知道他会为了它物而活成人人唾弃的样子。
夜色依旧深沉，远方的战声未曾停歇。二人检查完这片区域，确认无异常后，转身朝着值守木屋走去。手中的隐杀困伏符，也成了陈默在乱世之中，又一份自保的底气。

Chapter 26: Adventure in the woods and hidden objects (page 1)
The two of them walked forward and reached a remote cliffside forest in the back mountain. This place is far away from the main road, with wild grass everywhere and intertwined trees blocking the view. It is a weak point in defense. Su Wanqing spread all her consciousness and carefully checked for hidden dangers, while Chen Mo paid attention to the ground and grass.
While walking, he suddenly touched something under his feet. It felt hard and was buried under weeds and rotten leaves. Chen Mo bent down and pushed aside the layers of fallen leaves, only to see a palm-sized gray-brown wooden box lying quietly in the soil. The box was engraved with simple and obscure patterns, and there was a faint fluctuation of spiritual power on the surface.
The little white fox jumped down from his shoulder and circled the wooden box twice, sniffing lightly with the tip of its nose and a look of curiosity in its eyes.
Su Wanqing also walked closer quickly, her eyes fell on the wooden box, and after a little exploration, she could see the clues: "This is a small storage box left by the predecessors. There are no restrictions. Please open it and take a look."
Chen Mo opened the lid of the box as instructed. The box was empty except for a piece of dark cyan talisman paper lying flat. The talisman paper is made of a special material, with complex patterns painted on the paper. The aura is restrained and difficult for ordinary monks to detect.
"It's an ambush-type talisman." Su Wanqing recognized the purpose of the object at a glance, "This is a hidden killing and trapping talisman, a disposable magical weapon. Bury the talisman in the ground in advance, and when the enemy steps into the range, the maze and sneak attack aura will be automatically triggered, which is suitable for setting up an ambush in secret. The talisman has limited spiritual power and can only be used once, which is perfect for dealing with unprepared intruders."
After saying that, he took out a similar talisman from a snow-white and exquisite storage bag on his waist.
Chen Mo looked at it and found that the pattern on the talisman seemed much simpler compared to the one in his hand. And the blood used for the paint should also be the blood of ordinary beasts. And there is obviously a lot of spiritual energy fluctuation in the paint of the talisman in his hand.
Su Wanqing said in surprise: "This suit of yours seems to have been drawn by a master of talisman making. Even though it looks so old, the fluctuations in spiritual power are still extraordinary. You are really lucky." After that, he patted Chen Mo on the head. The fox on his shoulder looked back at her with vicious eyes.
Su Wanqing was a little surprised by this, so she gave the fox a small look in return. He thought to himself, "Is this fox jealous of me? It's really interesting. This fox seems to be very intelligent. Weird, weird."
Chen Mo picked up the talisman paper and touched the paper with his fingertips, feeling the condensed spiritual power sealed in it. He was overjoyed, but his face showed no expression at all. Now that the situation is chaotic, this unexpected gain undoubtedly provides an additional means of self-protection.
He carefully folded the talisman and unbuttoned his coat. He took one out of his underwear pocket. Cloth pocket with blue stripes. He opened it. , and found that there were many low-level talismans inside. This was handed to him quietly by his senior sister on the day he set out. He thought the master should have prepared it for him.
Thinking of the care of the master and the two senior sisters. He felt warm in his heart. In this society where you can throw away everything and give up your humanity for the sake of cultivation and treasures, these warm feelings have preserved the only civilization of mankind.
But for the sake of spiritual practice and the beliefs and ideals in our hearts, what can’t people do? The protagonist also doesn't know that he will live a life that is despised by everyone for the sake of other things.
The night was still dark, and the sound of war in the distance never stopped. After checking the area and confirming that there was nothing abnormal, the two turned and walked towards the guard cabin. The hidden killing and trapping talisman in his hand became another source of confidence for Chen Mo to protect himself in troubled times.
